llm.summary: This publish does not look like a coherent single skill; it appears to include an entire application repository with broad operational files and no top-level skill entry point.

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not present a clear single-skill purpose: there is no top-level SKILL.md, while the workspace contains a full ClawHub application repository, backend, CLI packages, workflows, node_modules, and many unrelated .agents skills.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are broad and mixed: AGENTS.md and multiple .agents/skills entries describe repository maintenance, production release, moderation, Convex, Axiom, Slack, Sentry, and dashboard operations rather than one bounded user-directed skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact shape is not proportionate for a text skill install because it includes package scripts, executable CLI wrappers, GitHub workflows, and dependency trees instead of a minimal skill bundle with clear install metadata.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The repository references many operational environment variables and services, including Convex, GitHub OAuth, JWT/JWKS, OpenAI, Axiom, Slack, Sentry, Grafana, and deployment tooling; that breadth is under-scoped for an unidentified skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: I did not find evidence of hidden automatic persistence or destructive execution on install, but the artifact includes high-impact publish, delete, deploy, moderation, and local install management workflows that require careful containment.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review this before installing because it appears to be a full development repository rather than a narrowly scoped OpenClaw skill. Install only if you intentionally want this repository-level agent context and understand the operational credentials, local files, and high-impact workflows it may expose to an agent.
